benchmark_type_evidence: We create new datasets for OCR, autocomplete, question answering, semantic parsing, and transliteration, and build on and refine existing datasets for other tasks.
brief_description: XTREME-UP is a multilingual benchmark focusing on user-centric tasks in a scarce-data setting for 88 under-represented languages across 9 key technologies including ASR, OCR, MT, and information access tasks. It standardizes multilingual in-language fine-tuning based on realistic annotation costs (8 hours per language).
